step1_analysis.description: A parallel LC tank circuit with parasitic series resistances for the inductor and capacitor, representing the passive resonator core of an LC-VCO.

paper_reference.title: Low-Power Low-Phase-Noise Differentially Tuned Quadrature VCO Design in Standard CMOS

Resonant Frequency (f_res).description: The frequency at which the tank impedance is purely resistive (phase = 0).

sky130_expected.calculation: f_res = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=1nH and C=7.4pF, f_res is approximately 1.85 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeted to match the paper's operating frequency range.

Quality Factor (Q).description: The ratio of energy stored to energy dissipated per cycle, determining the phase noise performance of the VCO.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported, but high-Q is implied for -143 dBc/Hz phase noise.

sky130_expected.calculation: Q = f_res / BW_3dB. Dominated by inductor Q = wL / R_L.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical Q factor for integrated spiral inductors in standard CMOS processes like SKY130.

Parallel Equivalent Resistance (Rp).description: The maximum impedance magnitude at resonance, which determines the required negative resistance (gm) to sustain oscillation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Rp = Q * w * L. With Q=10, w=2*pi*1.85e9, L=1nH, Rp is approx 116 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the expected Q factor and inductance value.

Phase Noise.description: Single sideband phase noise at a specific offset frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Cannot be measured on a passive tank alone, requires the full active VCO core.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the VCO core.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Cannot be measured on a passive tank alone.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the resonant frequency, quality factor, and parallel equivalent resistance of the LC tank using an AC current source to extract the impedance profile.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC Tank Impedance Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param L_val = 1n
.param C_val = 7.4p
.param RL_val = 1.16
.param RC_val = 0.1
.param R_val = 10k

* DUT
C N1 N3 {C_val}
R_C N3 N2 {RC_val}
L N1 N4 {L_val}
R_L N4 N2 {RL_val}
R N1 N2 {R_val}

* Stimulus
V_N2 N2 0 dc 0
I_test 0 N1 dc 0 ac 1

.control
ac dec 1000 100M 10G

let z_mag = mag(v(N1))
let z_phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N1))

* Measure maximum impedance (Parallel Equivalent Resistance Rp)
meas ac z_max max z_mag

* Measure resonant frequency (where phase crosses 0)
meas ac f_res when z_phase=0 fall=1

* Measure -3dB bandwidth using +/- 45 degree phase points
meas ac f_low when z_phase=45 fall=1
meas ac f_high when z_phase=-45 fall=1

* Calculate Quality Factor (Q)
let bw = f_high - f_low
let q_factor = f_res / bw

print f_res z_max q_factor
quit
.endc
.end
